name: sap-enterprise-plugin
description: SAP Enterprise Plugin v2.1 — Standalone multi-agent ecosystem for SAP S/4HANA Cloud discovery, implementation, and operations. Zero-API base mode. Deterministic templates, local validation scripts, Clean Core enforced. Designed by Javier Montaño.

changelog.2.1.0: Standalone plugin extracted from SDF v12.0. Multi-agent delegation framework with 6 specialists (sap-orchestrator, abap-expert, functional-lead, module-specialist, sap-docs-steward, qa-validator). 10 delegator commands. 12 deterministic templates. 5 local validation scripts. Zero-API base mode.

sap:discovery.description: Pipeline completo de SAP discovery (CP-0 → CP-8)

sap:fit-to-standard.description: Workshop Fit-to-Standard por Scope Item o módulo

sap:gap-analysis.description: Análisis y clasificación de gaps con ADRs

sap:generate-abap.description: Genera código ABAP Cloud (RAP + CDS + OData) con QA obligatorio

sap:migration-plan.description: Plan de migración Strangler Fig + Wave Plan + Cutover

sap:assess.description: Assessment de landscape SAP con 5D readiness scoring

sap:menu.description: Paleta interactiva de comandos SAP Enterprise

sap-orchestrator.description: Master conductor. Rutea a 5 especialistas, enforza quality gates G1/G2/G3.

abap-expert.description: ABAP Cloud + RAP + CDS + OData V4. Clean Core Level A enforcer.

functional-lead.description: Fit-to-Standard facilitator + gap scoring matrix owner.

module-specialist.description: Consultor granular por módulo SAP con templates específicos.

sap-docs-steward.description: Curador de referencias oficiales SAP. Rechaza hallucinations.

validate-deliverable.description: General deliverable QA (evidence tags, template, ghost menu)

detect-sap-context.description: Auto-detect SAP keywords in cwd, set TIPO_SERVICIO flag
